scope: Public preparation and starter packages; no competition assignment is supplied here
snapshot_type: Preparation template, not the live state of the user's competition project
null_fields_scope: These null/false values describe only what this public package supplies. They do not say that the current user has not already supplied a real ticket in the current conversation.
after_user_supplies_ticket: Use the actual supplied ticket and project-local CURRENT-TASK.md as the working task. Do not keep requesting it because this public snapshot has null/false fields. Record its source and distinguish exact requirements from implementation choices.
ticket_sources: The current user's actual expert-issued ticket, supplied in the current conversation or identified current project file
not_ticket_sources: Public CURRENT-TASK.md, HANDOFF.md, task forms and bracketed placeholders
Historical research, old dates, account assumptions or previous plans
Design demonstration names, sample records, courses, products, articles, forms and localStorage data
Source tests, QA fixtures and expected test outputs
Example ticket and acceptance tests reproduced inside the unapproved scoring draft
Generic architecture routes, suggested features, risk scenarios and conditional recommendations

source_example.document_status: Draft submitted for approval; approval not established
source_example.classification: Quoted source-document example only; not the current task or predicted competition ticket
source_example.preservation: Original PDF and full transcription remain intact

before_implementation: Identify the actual ticket source and distinguish its exact requirements from implementation choices
Do not infer a ticket from an example, a selected design, old HANDOFF text or a file being called CURRENT-TASK

When asked to implement the actual competition assignment, ask for a missing ticket; preparation or library-maintenance tasks proceed within the explicit current request without inventing a competition task
Do not assume a stage or build duration. Ask for essential missing time or rules without inventing a numeric limit
Once a real ticket is provided, map only its requirements and current user decisions to the implementation
current_project_state: Public templates start unfilled. Filled task and handoff files belong in the separate competition project, never automatically in this public headquarters.
default_architecture: User-approved preparation plan, not a mandatory organizer requirement or proof of deployed infrastructure
limits: This document describes source roles. It neither grants account access nor guarantees that another AI will follow the guidance.
maintenance_scope: A request to audit, improve preparation, maintain the library or build reusable tools is governed by the current user request and does not require an expert ticket. Ask for a ticket only when actually building the competition assignment.
